documents.text: Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement. On March 1, 2025, the Company entered into an equity line purchase agreement with Yorkville Advisors for up to $25,000,000. Under the equity line, the Company may sell shares from time to time. The purchase price is equal to 95% of the lowest daily VWAP during the pricing period.

Item 8.01 Other Events. On May 28, 2025, the Company sold and issued 2,500,000 shares of common stock to Yorkville under the equity line purchase agreement for gross proceeds of $1,250,000. The shares were issued pursuant to the equity line.
Prospectus supplement dated May 28, 2025. The Company sold 2,500,000 shares of common stock under its equity line for gross proceeds of approximately $1,250,000.
Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2025. The Company continues to evaluate financing alternatives. Net loss was $3,000,000 for the quarter.
